description: Twelve inputs arranged in a ring, crossfaded by one control that sweeps round it, with neighbouring inputs bleeding in by an adjustable amount

params.text: Sets the level of the input at that point of the ring, over silence to double
Sweeps the crossfade round the ring of twelve inputs, its full travel covering one complete turn; the maker set its minimum above its maximum, so it counts down as it is turned clockwise
Sets how many inputs either side of the selected point bleed in, over 1 to 4; at 1 only the selected input is heard
Scales the position CV before it is added to the selection, over -1 to 1; it starts at 0, so the position input does nothing until it is turned up
A latch that leaves unpatched inputs out of the ring, so the crossfade sweeps only the inputs with cables in them

inputs.text: One of the twelve signals mixed in the ring, scaled by its own trimpot and by how near the crossfade has come to it
Moves the crossfade round the ring through its attenuverter, which starts at 0

outputs.text: The sum of every input in the ring, each at its own trimpot level and its own crossfade weight

notes: The position input does nothing until its attenuverter is turned up, because that attenuverter starts at 0.
Each input has a lamp showing its crossfade weight, and the latch has a lamp of its own showing whether unpatched inputs are being skipped.
